sources_note: 今日新聞來源涵蓋 TechCrunch、Marketing Interactive、Campaign Asia、TechNode、量子位及 Kling AI 官方網誌，資料均為 2026 年 9 月 13–15 日發布，經原文連結核實後收錄。
sources_note_en: Today's sources include TechCrunch, Marketing Interactive, Campaign Asia, TechNode, 量子位 (Qbitai), and the Kling AI Official Blog. All articles verified with original permalinks published September 13–15, 2026.
thesis: OpenAI 進軍硬件、Apple Siri 接入 Gemini、Omnicom 萬人裁員——AI 正在同步重組廣告產業的技術基礎、消費觸點與代理版圖。
thesis_en: From OpenAI's hardware push and Apple's Gemini-powered Siri to Omnicom's mass layoffs — AI is simultaneously reshaping the tech stack, consumer touchpoints, and agency landscape of the ad industry.
thesis_note: 今日多個版塊均指向同一轉變：AI 不再只是創作輔助工具，而是正在滲透消費者裝置（iOS 27、Doubao）、媒體採購基礎設施（Omnicom／Publicis 重組）及跨平台廣告投放鏈（Google 第一方數據、百度直播轉型）。代理商需要在工具採購、人才配置與客戶溝通三個層面同步調整應對。
thesis_note_en: Multiple sections today converge on the same shift: AI is no longer just a creative assistant but is now penetrating consumer devices (iOS 27, Doubao), media buying infrastructure (Omnicom/Publicis restructuring), and cross-platform ad delivery chains (Google first-party data, Baidu livestream pivot). Agencies need to respond simultaneously across tooling, talent, and client communication.

items.title: OpenAI 以逾 3 億美元收購 AI 相機技術公司 Glass Imaging，加速硬體生態佈局
items.title_en: OpenAI Acquires AI Camera Startup Glass Imaging for $300M+, Accelerating Hardware Ecosystem Push
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布以逾 3 億美元收購由前 Apple Portrait Mode 工程師創辦的 Glass Imaging，加速整合消費電子與 AI 的硬體生態佈局，涵蓋手機與耳機產品線。
items.summary_en: OpenAI acquired AI-powered camera startup Glass Imaging for over $300M — founded by former Apple Portrait Mode engineers — as part of its push to build a consumer hardware ecosystem including phones and earbuds.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: OpenAI 由軟體走向硬體，未來可能以消費電子作廣告接觸點，代理商需提前研究影響。
items.why_en: OpenAI moving into hardware signals a future where ChatGPT reaches consumers through devices — agencies should monitor how this shifts media planning and touchpoint strategy.
highlights: Glass Imaging 由前 Apple Portrait Mode 工程師創辦，專攻 AI 相機技術，OpenAI 收購後預計整合入其規劃中的手機與耳機生態系統。
交易金額逾 3 億美元，顯示 OpenAI 正從 API 供應商轉型為消費電子平台，與 Apple、Google 的硬體佈局直接競爭。
AI 硬體與軟體的整合加速，廣告業未來的觸點版圖或因此出現根本性轉變，代理商應將消費者 AI 裝置納入媒體規劃視野。
highlights_en: Glass Imaging was co-founded by former Apple Portrait Mode engineers specialising in AI camera enhancement, and will be integrated into OpenAI's planned phones and earbuds ecosystem.
The $300M+ deal signals OpenAI's shift from a pure API/software provider to a vertically integrated consumer platform competing directly with Apple and Google hardware.
The accelerating merger of AI software and hardware may fundamentally reshape the advertising touchpoint landscape — agencies should begin factoring consumer AI devices into media planning.

items.title: Apple iOS／macOS 27 以 Google Gemini 重建 Siri，具備螢幕感知與多步驟任務能力
items.title_en: Apple Rebuilds Siri on Google Gemini in iOS/macOS 27 with Screen Awareness and Multi-Step Tasks
items.summary: iOS 27 與 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的 Siri 以 Gemini 模型重建，具備螢幕感知、鏡頭問答、Spotlight 自然語言搜尋及多步驟跨 App 任務執行，令評測者重拾日常使用習慣。
items.summary_en: Apple's iOS/macOS 27 rebuilds Siri on Google's Gemini models, adding screen-aware context, camera-based Q&A, natural-language Spotlight search, and multi-step cross-app task execution — making Siri a genuine daily-use AI assistant for the first time.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 香港 iPhone 普及率極高，Siri 成為真實 AI 助手後，消費者與品牌的互動模式將顯著改變。
items.why_en: With iPhone penetration extremely high in HK, a genuinely capable Siri changes how consumers interact with brands — agencies must factor Siri as an emerging consumer AI touchpoint in campaign planning.
highlights: iOS 27 Siri 由 Google Gemini 驅動，可讀取螢幕內容、用鏡頭即時回答問題，並完成跨 App 的多步驟任務，Apple × Google 的 AI 整合令每部 iPhone 成為原生智能入口。
macOS 27 Golden Gate 額外加入自然語言 Spotlight 搜尋（貫通郵件、文件與行事曆）及 AI 驅動的 Safari 標籤自動整理，直接挑戰 Notion AI 等獨立生產力工具。
代理商應評估 Siri 升級對 SEO、廣告觸達及消費者搜尋行為的潛在影響，特別是語音搜尋與語境化廣告插入的新機遇。
highlights_en: iOS 27 Siri — powered by Google Gemini — can read the device screen, answer questions via the camera, and complete multi-step cross-app tasks, turning every iPhone into an always-on intelligent interface.
macOS 27 adds natural-language Spotlight search across emails, files, and calendars, plus AI-powered Safari tab organisation, positioning it as a direct rival to standalone AI productivity apps.
Agencies should assess Siri's upgrade implications for SEO, ad reach, and consumer search behaviour — particularly emerging opportunities in voice search and contextual ad insertion.
items.pattern: iOS 27 與 macOS 27 是同一 AI 整合的兩個面向：Apple 在所有裝置統一部署 Gemini，標誌著消費者 AI 助手的進入門檻大幅下降，亦代表 Google 在 Apple 生態系統內取得重要分發地位。
items.pattern_en: iOS 27 and macOS 27 are two facets of the same integration: Apple deploying Gemini across its entire fleet signals a major drop in the barrier to consumer AI assistant adoption — and a significant distribution win for Google within Apple's ecosystem.

items.title: 多家 AI 龍頭 CEO 罕見一致呼籲主動放緩前沿模型開發，Nvidia CEO 公開反對
items.title_en: AI Lab Chiefs Align on Voluntary Slowdown in Frontier AI Development — Nvidia CEO Publicly Pushes Back
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 警告 RSI 或在 6–12 個月內出現，與 Sam Altman 及 Elon Musk 罕見達成共識，呼籲業界主動減速；Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳在 All-In Summit 明確反對，美國政策辯論同步升溫。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned RSI could emerge within 6–12 months and called for a voluntary industry slowdown — with Sam Altman and Elon Musk offering rare support — while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly opposed the call at the All-In Summit.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 頂級 AI 廠商集體喊停的訊號，可能影響 AI 廣告工具的功能迭代節奏，代理商需重新評估工具路線圖的穩定性。
items.why_en: A multi-lab voluntary slowdown could impact AI ad tool feature update cadence — agencies should pressure-test their AI tool roadmaps for resilience if iteration cycles slow down.
highlights: Dario Amodei 預警 RSI（超人工智能）或在 6–12 個月內超越人類能力，並聯與 Sam Altman 與 Elon Musk 呼籲主要 AI 廠商自願減速，三方在此議題上罕見達成共識。
Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳在 All-In Summit 接受特朗普現場來電後明確表態反對放緩，顯示 AI 硬體供應方與模型開發方之間存在根本性利益分歧。
此次辯論已上升至政治層面，美國兩黨與業界同步角力，未來 12 個月的監管走向將直接影響 AI 工具的可用性與成本。
highlights_en: Dario Amodei warned RSI could arrive within 6–12 months, and along with Sam Altman and Elon Musk called for a voluntary pause — a historically rare alignment across rival AI lab leaders.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly rejected the slowdown after a live call from President Trump at the All-In Summit, exposing a fundamental split between hardware suppliers and model developers.
The debate has reached the political level, with US bipartisan pressure building — the regulatory outcome over the next 12 months will directly affect AI tool availability and costs.
items.pattern: Nvidia 的反對反映硬體供應商與模型開發商之間的根本利益衝突：GPU 需求若因減速而下滑，Nvidia 首當其衝。代理商在評估 AI 工具投資時，需同時考慮算力供應鏈的政策風險。
items.pattern_en: Nvidia's opposition reflects a fundamental conflict of interest: a voluntary slowdown directly threatens GPU demand. Agencies evaluating AI tool investments should factor in compute supply chain policy risk alongside model capability roadmaps.

items.title: 智譜 AI 完成約 50 億美元融資以訓練下一代「完全自訓練」GLM 模型
items.title_en: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) Closes ~$5B Financing Round to Train Next-Generation 'Fully Self Training' GLM Models
items.summary: 智譜 AI 透過股份配售（約 20 億美元）及可換股債券（約 30 億美元）完成約 50 億美元融資，資金用於下一代 GLM 模型訓練、算力升級及自動化訓練數據生成，同期披露「完全自訓練」架構。
items.summary_en: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) closed approximately $5 billion in combined financing — ~$2B equity placement plus ~$3B convertible bonds — to fund next-generation GLM model training using a disclosed 'Fully Self Training' architecture.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: GLM 廣泛驅動中國 AI 行銷工具，大規模融資意味著廣告文案與創意工具能力將在未來 12 個月顯著躍升。
items.why_en: GLM underpins a wide range of Chinese AI marketing tools — this funding signals major capability upgrades for copywriting, creative generation, and campaign tools over the next 12 months.
highlights: 智譜 AI 本輪融資約達 50 億美元，為中國 AI 業界最大規模融資之一，同期披露下一代 GLM 將採用「完全自訓練」架構，大幅減少人工標注依賴。
「完全自訓練」架構涵蓋自動生成訓練數據、自建任務環境及自優化基礎設施三大維度，令模型迭代速度加快、成本降低。
GLM 被大量中國 AI 行銷工具採用，代理商應預期在 2026 年底前，使用 GLM 驅動的廣告文案、SEO 及社群內容生成工具的輸出質量將出現明顯變化。
highlights_en: Z.ai's ~$5B round is among China's largest ever AI financing deals, coinciding with the disclosure that its next-generation GLM will use a 'Fully Self Training' architecture that dramatically reduces human annotation dependence.
The architecture spans three dimensions: automated training data generation, self-built task environments, and self-optimising infrastructure — enabling faster iteration at lower cost.

GLM powers a wide range of Chinese AI marketing tools — agencies should expect material output quality changes from GLM-driven copywriting, SEO, and social content generation platforms before end-2026.
items.pattern: 智譜 AI 同期透過財報披露下一代 GLM 將採用「完全自訓練」架構，涵蓋自動化訓練數據生成、自建任務環境及自優化基礎設施，大幅減少人工標注依賴；此架構正是本輪融資的核心投向，代理商使用 GLM 驅動的廣告文案與創意工具，應預期 2026 年 Q4 前輸出質量出現顯著變化。
items.pattern_en: Z.ai concurrently disclosed via financial filings that the next-generation GLM will use a Fully Self Training architecture — automated training data generation, self-built task environments, and self-optimising infrastructure — drastically cutting human annotation dependence. This is the core target of the B raise; agencies using GLM-powered copywriting and creative tools should expect material output quality changes before Q4 2026.

items.title: Microsoft 發布 AI 行為準則，禁止模型製作深度偽造及欺騙用戶
items.title_en: Microsoft Publishes AI Code of Conduct Banning Deepfakes, Deception and Cyberattacks
items.summary: Microsoft 正式發布 AI 行為準則，明確禁止模型協助網路攻擊、製作深度偽造影片及欺騙用戶，並預測超人工智能將在十年內超越人類，引發業界對治理框架的廣泛討論。
items.summary_en: Microsoft published a formal AI code of conduct banning models from assisting cyberattacks, creating deepfakes, and deceiving users, while predicting superintelligent AI will surpass human capability within a decade.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: Microsoft 的約束性治理框架可能成為企業採購 AI 的合規基準，代理商向企業客戶推介 AI 服務時可作參考。
items.why_en: Microsoft's binding governance model may set an enterprise AI compliance benchmark — agencies pitching AI-powered services to risk-averse enterprise clients can reference this framework in proposals.
highlights: Microsoft 的 AI 行為準則明確禁止旗下模型協助網路攻擊、製作深度偽造內容及以任何形式欺騙用戶，屬業界較早發布的具約束力治理文件之一。
文件同時預測超人工智能（ASI）將在十年內超越人類整體能力，提示企業須提前部署 AI 治理架構以應對風險。
對於向企業客戶提供 AI 行銷服務的代理商，Microsoft 的框架可作為 AI 使用守則與客戶合規條款的參考基礎，有效降低企業採購阻力。
highlights_en: Microsoft's AI code of conduct explicitly bans its models from assisting cyberattacks, producing deepfake content, and deceiving users — making it one of the earliest binding governance documents from a major AI platform.
The document predicts artificial superintelligence (ASI) will surpass overall human capability within a decade, urging enterprises to establish AI governance frameworks proactively.

For agencies delivering AI marketing services to enterprise clients, the Microsoft framework provides a reference baseline for AI usage policies and client compliance terms, reducing procurement friction.

items.title: 字節跳動豆包手機助手正式推出消費者版，SAEP 協議允許跨 App 螢幕自動化操控
items.title_en: ByteDance Doubao Phone Assistant Launches Consumer Version with Cross-App SAEP Screen Automation
items.summary: 字節跳動豆包手機助手正式推出消費者版，採用 SAEP 協議實現跨 App 螢幕自動化操控，App 可自設 AI 可存取的功能邊界；首發機型為 9 月 16 日上市的 nubia NaviX Ultra。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao Phone Assistant launched its consumer version with AI-driven cross-app screen automation via the SAEP protocol — which lets apps define their own AI access boundaries — debuting on the nubia NaviX Ultra on September 16.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: SAEP 的 opt-in／opt-out 機制將影響用戶發現品牌的路徑，代理商需關注主要平台的接入決策對廣告觸達的影響。
items.why_en: SAEP's opt-in/opt-out mechanism changes how users discover brands across apps — agencies should monitor which major platforms participate and how it affects ad reach and purchase journey conversion.
highlights: 豆包手機助手消費者版採用 SAEP（螢幕 AI 執行協議），允許 AI 跨 App 自動執行操作，同時讓各 App 自行設定 AI 可觸及的功能邊界，首發機型為 9 月 16 日上市的 nubia NaviX Ultra。
字節跳動的 AI 手機策略直接與百度、小米等廠商競爭，SAEP 生態若擴大，用戶跨平台的使用行為將更大程度由 AI 助手代為整合。
若主要電商與社群平台選擇接入 SAEP，用戶購物路徑可能繞開傳統廣告觸點，代理商需提前評估對客戶廣告轉化的潛在影響。
highlights_en: Doubao Phone Assistant uses the SAEP (Screen AI Execution Protocol) for cross-app automation while giving each app control over its own AI access boundaries, debuting on the nubia NaviX Ultra on September 16.

ByteDance's AI phone strategy directly competes with Baidu, Xiaomi, and other Chinese hardware players — if the SAEP ecosystem expands, AI assistants will increasingly mediate cross-platform user behaviour.
If major e-commerce and social platforms opt into SAEP, consumer purchase journeys may bypass traditional ad touchpoints — agencies should assess the potential impact on client conversion paths.

items.title: 百度百家號 App 於 9 月 22 日更名「百度直播伴侶」，非直播創作者移轉主 App
items.title_en: Baidu Baijiahao App Rebrands as 'Baidu Live Companion' on Sept 22 — Non-Livestream Creators Migrated to Main App
items.summary: 百度將於 9 月 22 日把百家號 App 更名為「百度直播伴侶」，全面聚焦直播業務；非直播創作者的內容管理功能將移轉至百度主 App 的創作中心，創作者生態一分為二。
items.summary_en: Baidu is rebranding its Baijiahao creator app as Baidu Live Companion on September 22, pivoting entirely to livestream-focused creators, while migrating non-livestream content management to the creator centre inside the main Baidu app.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 在百度平台有內容行銷部署的代理商，需在 9 月 22 日前完成直播與圖文工作流程的分拆準備。
items.why_en: Agencies with Baidu content marketing plans must complete tool migration before September 22 and reassess whether to increase investment in Baidu livestream strategy.
highlights: 百度百家號 App 將於 9 月 22 日正式更名為「百度直播伴侶」，顯示百度全面押注直播帶貨，以對抗抖音、快手的競爭壓力。
非直播創作者（包括圖文、短影片等）的管理功能將從獨立 App 移至百度主 App 的創作中心，部分工作流程需要相應調整。
在百度平台有整合內容行銷計劃的代理商，需在 9 月 22 日前完成團隊工具遷移準備，並評估直播策略是否值得加大投入。
highlights_en: Baijiahao officially becomes Baidu Live Companion on September 22, marking Baidu's full pivot toward livestream commerce to counter Douyin and Kuaishou competitive pressure.
Non-livestream creators (articles, short video) will have their management tools moved from the standalone app to the creator centre in the main Baidu app, requiring workflow updates.
Agencies with integrated Baidu content marketing plans should complete tool migration preparation before September 22 and reassess the ROI of increasing investment in Baidu livestream.

items.title: Publicis 贏得百事可樂全球媒體業務後，主動退出可口可樂全球媒體比稿
items.title_en: Publicis Withdraws from Coca-Cola Global Media Pitch After Landing PepsiCo Account
items.summary: Publicis 在贏得百事可樂全球媒體業務後，主動退出可口可樂全球媒體比稿以迴避客戶衝突，凸顯大型代理集團在巨型飲料品牌之間的取捨邏輯，可口可樂業務出現空缺。
items.summary_en: Publicis voluntarily withdrew from Coca-Cola's global media pitch following its win of PepsiCo's account, avoiding a direct category conflict — highlighting the zero-sum trade-offs mega-brands force on holding groups, leaving a gap in the Coca-Cola review.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 大型媒體業務的客戶衝突規則正重塑全球代理版圖，本地獨立代理商可評估由此釋放的業務機遇。
items.why_en: Client conflict rules in mega-media reviews are reshaping the global agency landscape — independent agencies should assess which account opportunities may open up as holding groups face these constraints.
highlights: Publicis 在獲得百事可樂全球媒體業務後，主動退出可口可樂的全球媒體比稿，此次涉及全球規模的媒體整合採購，影響多個市場的代理業務版圖。
此舉凸顯跨國飲料品牌組合在大型代理集團內形成的結構性衝突，Omnicom、WPP 等其他集團亦面臨類似的選擇壓力。
Publicis 退出後，可口可樂全球媒體業務出現競爭空缺，業界正密切關注下一輪競爭者名單，潛在機遇對中小型獨立媒體代理商亦具參考價值。
highlights_en: Publicis withdrew from Coca-Cola's global media pitch after securing PepsiCo's account — involving integrated global-scale media buying affecting agency business across multiple markets.
The move highlights the structural conflict mega beverage brands create for large holding groups; Omnicom, WPP, and others face similar forced trade-offs.

Publicis' exit leaves a competitive gap in the Coca-Cola global media review — the industry is closely watching the next contender list, with potential implications even for mid-size independent media agencies.

items.title: Omnicom 因失去百事可樂帳戶，預計 2026 年底前裁員約 1.5 萬人
items.title_en: Omnicom to Cut ~15,000 Jobs by End-2026 Following Loss of PepsiCo Account
items.summary: Omnicom 在失去百事可樂全球媒體帳戶後，預計於 2026 年底前裁減約 1.5 萬名員工；CFO 稱帳戶離開反而可釋放空間拓展競品客戶，縮減規模或成新常態。
items.summary_en: Omnicom anticipates cutting roughly 15,000 jobs by end-2026 following the loss of PepsiCo's global media account, with its CFO noting the departure may actually unlock new category client opportunities.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 全球最大代理集團之一的大規模裁員影響行業人才流動，對香港本地代理商既是預警訊號亦是招募機遇。
items.why_en: Mass layoffs at one of the world's largest holding groups will trigger industry talent movement — a risk signal for business volume tracking and a recruitment opportunity for agencies looking to hire experienced talent.
highlights: Omnicom 預計在 2026 年底前裁員約 1.5 萬人，是該集團有史以來規模最大的人員削減計劃之一，直接觸發點為失去百事可樂全球媒體業務。
Omnicom CFO 表示，失去百事可樂反而令集團可以自由爭取其他飲料與食品類別的競品客戶，潛在業務機遇料將緩和部分損失。
此次裁員波及香港及亞太區辦公室的可能性不可忽視，本地代理業界應密切追蹤 Omnicom 旗下 PHD、OMD、BBDO 等品牌的人員動向。
highlights_en: Omnicom plans to cut approximately 15,000 jobs by end-2026 in one of the largest headcount reductions in the group's history, directly triggered by the loss of PepsiCo's global media account.
Omnicom's CFO noted that losing PepsiCo frees the group to pursue competing beverage and food category clients, potentially offsetting some of the revenue loss.
The layoffs may affect Omnicom's Hong Kong and APAC offices — agencies in the region should monitor talent movements at PHD, OMD, BBDO, and other Omnicom brands.

items.title: 微信小範圍測試 AI 圖像處理功能，涵蓋去背、風格改變及文字提取
items.title_en: WeChat Trials AI Image Processing Tools Including Background Removal, Style Change and Text Extraction
items.summary: 微信正對部分用戶開放 AI 圖像處理工具，包括去背、風格改變、去浮水印、解析度增強及圖片內文字提取，功能直接整合於圖片發送介面，無需切換獨立 App。
items.summary_en: WeChat is trialling AI image editing tools — background removal, style changes, watermark removal, resolution enhancement, and text extraction — directly within its image-sending interface for select users.
items.why: 微信原生 AI 圖像工具普及後，品牌素材的輕量製作門檻將大幅下降，代理商需評估現有設計工序的調整空間。
items.why_en: Native AI image tools within WeChat will lower the bar for lightweight brand asset creation — agencies should assess how this affects their design workflows and value proposition.
highlights: 微信正小範圍測試 AI 圖像處理工具組，功能涵蓋去背景、風格轉換、物件移除、去浮水印、解析度增強及文字提取，全部整合於現有圖片發送介面，無需切換獨立 App。
若功能全面推出，微信生態內的品牌素材製作（如活動宣傳圖、客服圖文素材）將可在平台內直接完成基礎修圖，減少對 Adobe、Canva 等獨立設計工具的依賴。
代理商需重新評估輕量設計服務的差異化定位：當客戶可直接在微信內處理基礎圖片需求時，代理商應聚焦高難度創意執行與品牌一致性管理。
highlights_en: WeChat is testing an AI image processing toolset — background removal, style transfer, object removal, watermark removal, resolution enhancement, and in-image text extraction — integrated directly into the existing image-sending interface.
If rolled out broadly, WeChat-native brand asset creation (event promotions, service imagery) could bypass standalone design tools like Adobe or Canva for basic editing needs.

Agencies should reassess their positioning for lightweight design services: as clients handle basic image needs natively in WeChat, agencies should focus on high-complexity creative execution and brand consistency governance.

items.title: Superhuman 收購 AI 會議記錄工具 Fathom，整合入代理人工作流程平台
items.title_en: Superhuman Acquires AI Meeting Notetaker Fathom, Building Agentic Workflow Platform for 40M Users
items.summary: Superhuman 收購 YC 孵化的 AI 會議記錄工具 Fathom（估值 9,400 萬美元），將會議語境整合入其電郵、行事曆與 AI 代理人構建器平台，服務超過 4,000 萬用戶，推進代理人式工作流程。
items.summary_en: Superhuman acquired YC-backed AI meeting notetaker Fathom (valued at $94M) to integrate meeting context into its email, calendar, and AI agent-builder platform serving 40 million users, advancing the agentic workflow trend.
items.why: 會議 AI 融入生產力平台的趨勢正在加速，代理商從客戶 brief 到交付物的工作流程自動化程度將持續提升。
items.why_en: Meeting AI consolidating into productivity platforms accelerates agentic workflow automation for agencies — from client brief to deliverable, the automation chain is getting longer and more capable.
highlights: Superhuman 收購估值 9,400 萬美元的 AI 會議記錄工具 Fathom，整合後 Superhuman 用戶可在電郵及行事曆介面直接調取會議摘要、行動項目及客戶語境，無需切換工具。
此次整合將 Superhuman 從「AI 電郵工具」升級至「代理人工作流程中樞」，透過 AI 代理人構建器連接會議→任務→郵件→執行的完整閉環。
代理商帳戶管理團隊若已使用 Superhuman，應評估整合後的 AI 代理人功能是否可自動化客戶溝通週期中的重複環節，包括跟進電郵、會議摘要及任務分派。
highlights_en: Superhuman acquired Fathom, valued at $94M — post-integration, users can access meeting summaries, action items, and client context directly from their email and calendar interface without switching tools.
This positions Superhuman as an 'agentic workflow hub' rather than just an AI email tool, connecting the full loop of meeting → task → email → execution via its AI agent builder.

Agency account management teams using Superhuman should evaluate whether post-integration AI agent features can automate repetitive elements of client communication cycles, such as follow-up emails, meeting summaries, and task assignments.

items.title: Stagwell Assembly 任命新全球 CEO，Connie Chan 晉升領導亞太區
items.title_en: Stagwell Assembly Names New Global CEO, Promotes Connie Chan to Lead APAC
items.summary: Stagwell 旗下媒體代理 Assembly 任命 Liz Rutgersson 為全球 CEO，Connie Chan 同步晉升為亞太區 CEO，集團強調以 AI 效率結合人類創意推動區域增長。
items.summary_en: Stagwell appointed Liz Rutgersson as global CEO of Assembly and elevated Connie Chan to APAC CEO, with the group emphasising AI-human creative collaboration as the growth engine for the Asia-Pacific region.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: Assembly 亞太區領導層換血直接影響香港本地的競爭格局與業務拓展動向，值得密切追蹤。
items.why_en: Assembly's APAC leadership change directly reshapes the competitive landscape in HK and the region — agencies should monitor new strategic priorities and potential account movements.
highlights: Assembly 任命 Liz Rutgersson 為全球 CEO，並晉升 Connie Chan 為亞太區 CEO，兩人均有深厚的數位媒體與廣告科技背景。
集團將 AI 效率與人類創意的融合定位為亞太區核心增長策略，暗示 Assembly 將在自動化媒體採購與數據驅動創意方面加大投入。
Assembly 在香港及大灣區的業務擴張計劃值得持續追蹤，領導層轉換期往往伴隨客戶及人才的重新分配，對同業代理商既是挑戰亦是機遇。
highlights_en: Assembly appointed Liz Rutgersson as global CEO and promoted Connie Chan to APAC CEO, both with strong backgrounds in digital media and adtech.
The group positioned AI-human creative collaboration as its core APAC growth strategy, signalling increased investment in automated media buying and data-driven creative for the region.

Assembly's expansion plans in Hong Kong and the GBA warrant ongoing monitoring — leadership transitions typically trigger client and talent realignments that present both challenges and opportunities for competing agencies.

items.title: SPH Media 聘任前 X 高管擔任媒體行銷主管，以 AI 受眾洞察為核心任務
items.title_en: SPH Media Hires Former X Executive as Head of Media Marketing with AI Audience Insights as Top Priority
items.summary: SPH Media 委任曾任職 X（前 Twitter）的 Tina Pang 為媒體行銷主管，明確聚焦 AI 驅動受眾洞察、廣告效能提升及內容授權三大優先任務，傳統媒體集團加速轉型廣告科技平台。
items.summary_en: SPH Media appointed former X executive Tina Pang as head of media marketing, explicitly prioritising AI-driven audience discovery, campaign effectiveness, and content licensing as her top three mandates.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 媒體主以廣告科技背景人才重塑商業化能力，折射出媒體生態對 AI 及第一方數據的日益重視。
items.why_en: Media owners recruiting adtech-trained executives signals a broader shift toward AI and first-party data capabilities — relevant for agencies renegotiating publisher partnerships and audience deals.
highlights: SPH Media 委任 Tina Pang 為媒體行銷主管，Pang 曾任職 X（前 Twitter），具備數位廣告銷售及平台變現的豐富經驗。
SPH Media 明確將 AI 驅動受眾發現、廣告效能測量及內容授權列為三大即時優先事項，顯示傳統媒體集團正在加速向數據驅動的廣告業務模式轉型。
代理商在為客戶採購 SPH Media 版位時，應預期其廣告產品在未來 6–12 個月將有顯著升級，可借此重啟更有利的合作條款談判。
highlights_en: SPH Media appointed Tina Pang as head of media marketing; Pang previously held digital ad sales and platform monetisation roles at X (formerly Twitter).

SPH Media explicitly named AI-driven audience discovery, ad effectiveness measurement, and content licensing as its three immediate top priorities, signalling an accelerating pivot to data-driven ad models.

Agencies buying SPH Media inventory for clients should expect significant ad product upgrades over the next 6–12 months, creating an opportunity to renegotiate partnership terms on more favourable bases.

items.title: Gojek 以微短劇形式惡搞 Grab 同名系列，雙方互動引爆社群討論
items.title_en: Gojek Releases Microdrama Parody of Grab's Series — Brand Rivalry Exchange Goes Viral
items.summary: Gojek 新加坡以微短劇形式惡搞 Grab 同名系列，直接模仿其視覺風格並植入 GoCar 服務，Grab 隨即以與款語氣回應，雙方品牌互動引爆社群自發討論，雙方均獲大量有機曝光。
items.summary_en: Gojek Singapore released a microdrama parody mirroring Grab's visual style and narrative structure while promoting GoCar — Grab responded playfully in kind, turning the brand rivalry into a viral two-way social exchange with significant organic reach for both.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 競爭品牌借勢對手創意的低成本 Reactive Marketing 案例，直接可用於向香港客戶提案社群創意策略。
items.why_en: A low-cost reactive marketing case study showing how to leverage a competitor's creative moment — directly applicable to pitching social content strategy to HK clients.
highlights: Gojek 製作了直接模仿 Grab 微短劇視覺語言的仿諷影片，在品牌語境與劇情走向上均有意致敬原作，最終以 GoCar 服務作為轉折點，以低成本製作引發高話題討論。
Grab 以同款輕鬆語氣回應 Gojek 的挑釁，雙方的互動式交鋒成功引爆社群討論，令兩個品牌同時獲得大量有機曝光，展示 reactive marketing 的雙贏潛力。
此案例示範了「競爭型 Reactive Marketing」的高效路徑：以極低製作成本，藉助競品已建立的受眾認知創造差異化話題，是向資源有限客戶推薦快速回應社群策略的理想參考案例。
highlights_en: Gojek produced a microdrama parody that deliberately mimicked Grab's visual language and narrative structure, pivoting to promote GoCar as the punchline — generating high engagement at low production cost.

Grab responded in the same playful tone, turning the brand rivalry into a two-way social exchange that generated significant organic reach for both brands simultaneously, demonstrating the win-win potential of reactive marketing.

This case demonstrates the mechanics of 'competitive reactive marketing': using a competitor's established audience recognition to create differentiation at minimal cost — an ideal reference case for agencies pitching rapid-response social strategies to budget-conscious clients.

items.title: Samsung 找到真實同名「Tim Cook」為 Galaxy Z Fold8 拍攝社群影片，借 Apple 發布節點打話題
items.title_en: Samsung Enlists a Real 'Tim Cook' from New Zealand to Review Galaxy Z Fold8 at Apple's iPhone 18 Launch
items.summary: Samsung 紐西蘭在 Palmerston North 找到真實同名「Tim Cook」，製作 Instagram 系列影片推廣 Galaxy Z Fold8，精準選在 Apple 發布 iPhone 18 Duo 同期推出，低成本製造高話題。
items.summary_en: Samsung New Zealand recruited a real man named Tim Cook from Palmerston North to review the Galaxy Z Fold8 in a series of Instagram videos, timed precisely to Apple's iPhone 18 Duo announcement for maximum earned media.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 借競品發布節點製造低成本高話題的創意案例，示範如何以創意取代製作預算打造社群引爆點。
items.why_en: A textbook case of leveraging a competitor's launch moment with minimal budget — applicable to teaching clients how to create social talkability without expensive production.
highlights: Samsung 紐西蘭選在 Apple 發布 iPhone 18 Duo 的同期，推出由真實叫「Tim Cook」的紐西蘭人拍攝的 Galaxy Z Fold8 Instagram 影片系列，以真實姓名巧合製造話題共鳴，吸引大量媒體主動報道。
此創意無需大型製作預算，僅靠策略性的時機選擇與真實姓名的巧合，即可引發廣泛媒體報道與社群自發分享，成本效益極高。
此案例示範了「newsjacking 借勢行銷」的低成本路徑：識別競品的高關注時刻，以創意切入點製造差異化討論，是代理商在 pitch 中展示輕資本社群策略的理想範本。
highlights_en: Samsung New Zealand timed its 'Tim Cook reviews Galaxy Z Fold8' Instagram series to coincide with Apple's iPhone 18 Duo launch — using the real-name coincidence as a hook for organic media pickup.
The campaign required no large production budget; strategic timing and the name coincidence alone generated widespread earned media and organic social sharing at extremely high cost-efficiency.

This demonstrates the low-cost mechanics of newsjacking: identify a competitor's high-attention moment and create a differentiated creative hook — a ready-made template for agencies pitching lean social strategies in client pitches.

items.title: 可靈 VIDEO 3.0 Omni 官方教學：用手繪圖稿三步驟完成 4K AI 動畫短片
items.title_en: Kling VIDEO 3.0 Omni Official Tutorial: Turn Hand-Drawn Art into a 4K AI Animation in Three Steps
items.summary: 可靈官方教學示範用手繪圖稿搭配 VIDEO 3.0 Omni 圖像轉影片功能，配合 Custom Multi-Shot 分鏡及 Native Audio 五語種配音，三步驟完成 4K 動畫短片，大幅降低動畫製作門檻。
items.summary_en: Kling AI's official step-by-step guide shows how to turn scanned hand-drawn art into a 4K animated short using VIDEO 3.0 Omni's image-to-video, Custom Multi-Shot storyboarding, and Native Audio multi-language dubbing features.
items.why: 代理創意團隊可直接用草圖或分鏡手稿驅動 AI 動畫，省去完整動畫製作流程，大幅縮短社群影片製作週期。
items.why_en: Agency creatives can turn storyboard sketches directly into animated content via AI, bypassing the full animation pipeline and cutting social video production cycles significantly.
highlights: 官方教學流程：上傳手繪圖稿作參考 → 撰寫分鏡動態提示詞 → 以 Custom Multi-Shot 編排鏡次並配置 Native Audio 配音 → 輸出最高 4K 動畫影片；全程在 Kling 平台內完成，無需額外動畫軟體。
Native Audio 支援五種語言的 AI 配音，可直接生成多語種版本，適合大灣區需要繁體中文與英文雙語版本的品牌內容製作。
此流程的核心技巧為「每次只改一個變數迭代」：固定分鏡結構，僅調整動態提示詞，快速測試不同動畫風格，適合社群廣告的 A/B 測試需求。
highlights_en: The official workflow: upload hand-drawn reference art → write directorial motion prompts → configure Custom Multi-Shot cut structure and Native Audio dubbing → export up to 4K; the entire process runs within Kling with no additional animation software.
Native Audio supports AI dubbing in five languages, enabling direct multilingual versioning — ideal for GBA brands needing both Traditional Chinese and English content from the same creative asset.

The key production insight is 'change only one variable per iteration': lock the storyboard structure, vary only the motion prompts to rapidly test animation styles — well-suited to social ad A/B testing workflows.

items.title: 可靈 IMAGE 3.0 Omni 圖像系列模式：一次上傳 10 張參考圖批量生成風格統一的廣告素材
items.title_en: Kling IMAGE 3.0 Omni Image Series Mode: Upload 10 References to Batch-Generate Style-Consistent Campaign Assets at 4K
items.summary: 可靈 IMAGE 3.0 Omni 的「Image Series Mode」支援上傳最多 10 張參考圖，一次生成風格統一的多圖組，原生輸出 2K／4K 解析度，適合需要大量視覺一致素材的廣告投放。
items.summary_en: Kling AI's IMAGE 3.0 Omni Image Series Mode accepts up to 10 brand reference images to generate a style-consistent multi-image set in one run, with native 2K/4K output — designed for campaigns requiring large volumes of visually consistent assets.
items.why: 一次生成整套風格統一的廣告素材，省去重複調整時間，特別適合需要大量素材版本的社群廣告投放。
items.why_en: Batch-generating a full set of style-consistent ad creatives in one run cuts repetitive production time — especially valuable for social ad campaigns requiring multiple creative variants across formats.
highlights: Image Series Mode 允許一次上傳最多 10 張品牌或產品參考圖，系統自動學習視覺風格後生成整套風格統一的圖像組，原生解析度支援 2K 及 4K，可直接用於廣告素材。
此功能特別適合「一稿多版」的廣告需求：電商促銷輪播廣告、品牌 Story 廣告及 Banner 系列，可在一次生成中確保所有素材的品牌視覺一致性。
推薦工作流程：將品牌 VI 手冊的核心視覺元素（主色、產品角度、排版風格）製成參考圖上傳，讓 AI 學習品牌語言後批量生成活動素材，取代人工逐張調整的流程。
highlights_en: Image Series Mode accepts up to 10 brand or product reference images in a single upload; the system learns the visual style and generates a style-consistent image set at native 2K/4K resolution, ready for direct ad use.

This feature is especially suited to 'one brief, multiple variants' use cases: e-commerce promotion carousels, brand Story ads, and banner series can all be generated in a single run with consistent brand visuals across every asset.

Recommended workflow: extract core visual elements from the brand VI manual (primary colours, product angles, typographic style) as reference images, let the AI learn the brand language, then batch-generate campaign assets — replacing manual asset-by-asset adjustment.
